data_description.price_entity: Sensor that holds the published hourly prices in an attribute, for example the Zonneplan hourly tariff sensor.
data_description.control_mode_entity: Master switch for forcing: enable or disable.
data_description.force_mode_entity: Direction when forcing: charge, discharge or stop.
data_description.force_power_entity: Set to the spread-out power while charging.
data_description.max_power_entity: Sets the number of charge hours and the upper limit of the power. Empty = 2500 W.
data_description.capacity_entity: Empty = the fixed capacity from the options.
data_description.charged_energy_entity: Together with the discharged energy this sets the efficiency. Empty = fixed efficiency.
data_description.default_efficiency: The efficiency is calculated from the Marstek energy counters (total discharged divided by total charged). This fixed value only applies when those counters are not set or have no value.
data_description.margin: After the charging loss, charging has to gain at least this amount.
data_description.top_hours: An hour is cheap enough when its price is below the efficiency times the average of these most expensive hours after it, minus the margin.
data_description.min_lookahead_hours: Hours with fewer known prices after them are ignored.
data_description.force_discharge_power_entity: Needed for selling. Empty = selling is not possible.
data_description.max_discharge_power_entity: Upper limit of the sell power. Empty = 2500 W.
data_description.min_soc_entity: The Marstek does not discharge below this SoC. Empty = the fixed value from the options.
data_description.sell_margin: Selling only happens when the sell price exceeds the cost of recharging (charge price divided by the efficiency) plus this amount.
data_description.house_power: Sets the reserve: this power times the hours until recharging stays in the battery.
data_description.min_soc: Only used when no discharge cut-off entity is set.
data_description.sell_price_factor: Sell price = hourly price times this factor, minus the deduction. With net metering: 1 and 0. Without, for example 0.826 and 0.108 for the bare market price.
data_description.negative_price_limit: Below this hourly price the battery always charges at full power (when the switch is on). Default 0: only at a truly negative price.
